sections.title: The GT7 traps
rows: In GT7 camber acts mid-corner and costs braking and traction immediately. Start 1.0–1.5°, not 3.0.
Front compression damping (lower), front ARB, front toe, brake balance. Not camber.
May be inverted vs real life. A/B −0.05 / 0.00 / +0.05 per car. Never run toe-in at the front.
Lengthening 1st/2nd/3rd is the top-ranked GT7 traction fix, ahead of every diff and spring change.
It's a generator, not a trim. Set it first, then final drive, then individual gears. Never touch it again.
Post-1.49, raise ride height 3–5 mm first. A car that suddenly won't turn is arch rub, not balance.
negative = FRONT, positive = REAR. It's a delta from each car's own factory bias.
Suspension, gears and LSD values cost zero PP. Fitting the parts costs PP. Aero is not free.
~1,300 lb of downforce measured at ~0.1 s/lap. Use aero for balance, not for grip.
Tyre pressure, caster, brake pressure, high/low-speed damper split. None exist in GT7.
